REV-01 per-wave ICBM descent speed, integer byte of the "frames before update" period (SET UP ICBM SPEED, WICSPH). REV-01-vs-REV-03 delta (O-3): these WICSPH/WICSPL/ICBWAV difficulty tables are exactly where REV-01 (035820-01, the vendored tree) and REV-03 (035820-02, the widely-emulated "missile") diverge; this ships REV-01 per epic contract 3, and the exact REV-03 deltas require the REV-03 source, which is not in the vendored REV-01 tree.
8.8 fixed-point scale for the ICBM update period: ICSPDL is declared as a one-byte FRACTION of a frame, so its weight is 1/256 (period = ICSPDH + ICSPDL/256).

End-of-wave CITY BONUS: a saved city is worth 4 ICBM-point units. ENDWV4 (TALLY CITIES) calls ICMUL2 with LDX I,3, and ICMUL2's MIEND loop runs while X>=0, so the per-ICBM value (ICBPTS) is added 4 times per surviving city. Value is the LDX immediate (3, hex) + 1 for the inclusive loop; the cited line's own comment reads "4 ICBM POINTS/CITY". At the base multiplier that is 4 x 25 = 100 pts/city.

End-of-wave UNUSED-MISSILE BONUS: 5 points per ABM left in a magazine. ENDWV2 calls ABMADD per unused ABM; ABMADD adds the immediate 5 to the bonus triple once per SMULTI (skill/score multiplier), so the base rate is 5 pts/unused ABM. Value is the LDA I,5 immediate.
